parameters.content:
## 04 Autonomous Research Agent

question -> plan -> parallel web search -> deduplicate -> synthesise -> verify -> provenance map.

Both prompts come from the GitOps registry and both model calls go through the Model Router, so the provider, prompt version and cost of every run are recorded in the report.

## Evidence hygiene

Deduplication runs in two stages: exact match on a normalised URL (tracking parameters, `www.`, trailing slashes and fragments stripped) and then near-duplicate detection using 3-word shingles with a Jaccard threshold of 0.8, which catches syndicated copies of the same article.

If every search comes back empty the agent stops and reports a gap. It never writes an unsourced answer.

## Citations are checked, not trusted

The report is passed to the Verification Layer with the collected sources attached, so every claim is labelled SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED or NOT_STATED against the evidence that was actually retrieved.

The provenance map records which sources were cited, which were collected but unused, and any `[S#]` marker the model invented that does not correspond to a real source.
